u0: Initial RM state: no non-exit step has yet been completed while holding the box. The agent may or may not currently hold it, and the box may be absent, on the floor, or recovered later. Next objective: reach the exit, preferably while holding the box; picking up or retaining the box and carrying it through a non-exit step advances to u1, while reaching the exit ends the episode here with the box bonus if applicable.
u1: One non-exit step has been completed while holding the box. Current possession is not guaranteed, so the agent may now be carrying it or have lost/dropped it. Next objective: complete a second distinct non-exit step while holding the box to advance to u2, then reach the exit; reaching the exit now also terminates the episode, with the box bonus if the box is held.
u2: The box has already been held on at least two different non-exit steps, so the preference for carrying it across multiple moves is satisfied. The box may still be carried or may have been lost, but it is no longer needed for RM progress. Next objective: reach the exit and terminate the episode; any exit step moves to u3 regardless of current possession.
u3: Terminal RM state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode is complete. No further objective remains; the payoff depends on the path taken and whether the box was held at the exit.
